svg.text: Perimeter elevations - fixture constraints and proposed decoration
DESIGN COORDINATION / PROPOSED DECORATION / NOT CONSTRUCTION OR FIRE-CODE APPROVAL
Fixed exterior 14,260 x 11,000 | Clear interior 13,900 x 10,640 | All dimensions mm; heights above finished floor.
OPEN CHILLER - NO POSTERS ON AIR INTAKE
N01 is on the existing rest-door head. N02 replaces the small floating drinks sign.
Window graphic bounding boxes: 2.8% of the 12,000 x 1,800 glazed area. No new mullions.
Keep +780 worktops; no raised office floor or upper storey.
1 Grey: existing fixture envelope. Blue tint: glazing. Green / terracotta: proposed decoration.
2 Red dashed areas remain clear: door leaves, movement openings and reserved service space.
3 Reuse original Sakura / J Coffee / flower artwork and props. New category copy is original.
4 Keep refrigeration fans, vents, door handles, sensors and shelf access free of decoration.
5 Poster layer offsets: 8 mm nominal; frames 20 mm maximum. Verify face normals and no flicker.
6 Drawings are a proposal against branch geometry, not proof that all assets are already relocated.
Height datum: finished floor +0. No wall decoration above +2,650. Ceiling remains +2,800.
